summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K announcing its 2026 half-year results, including an interim dividend of 2.4 pence per ordinary share, up 9% year-over-year, with payment expected on 17 September 2026 and record date 14 August 2026. The filing also provides details on the dividend reinvestment programme and a results presentation by the CEO and CFO. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No transaction or strategic review is disclosed.
